37.DetailDescription1: Adventuring through the void is a cruel game of the jungle, where only the strongest can ascend to the throne. It's cold and hard as iron, but the ambitious will always flock to it in droves.
37.DetailDescription2: The emblem hangs high above the throne, shimmering with gold and glittering with cold, its every glimmer a silent declaration: only a true king suits it, and all other seekers are obscured in the shadow it casts.
37.DetailDescription3: Within the colorful ribbons are intertwined glory and ambition. On one side stands a mass of warriors, their gazes burning as they stare across the shore. On the other side, the sole true king sits high atop the throne, shrouded in majesty like the center of heaven and earth.
37.DetailDescription4: Shining out from the throne, the cold yet searing light seems to whisper a song of glory while scorching into ashes the aspirations of any who dare approach.

38.Description: I came, I saw, I conquered.
38.HowToGet: Guild ranks No.1 in Vault of Time or within the top 5 in regional Vault of Time.
38.DetailDescription1: Adventuring through the void is a cruel game of the jungle, where only the strongest can ascend to the throne. It's cold and hard as iron, but the ambitious will always flock to it in droves.
38.DetailDescription2: The emblem hangs high above the throne, shimmering with gold and glittering with cold, its every glimmer a silent declaration: only a true king suits it, and all other seekers are obscured in the shadow it casts.
38.DetailDescription3: Within the colorful ribbons are intertwined glory and ambition. On one side stands a mass of warriors, their gazes burning as they stare across the shore. On the other side, the sole true king sits high atop the throne, shrouded in majesty like the center of heaven and earth.
38.DetailDescription4: Shining out from the throne, the cold yet searing light seems to whisper a song of glory while scorching into ashes the aspirations of any who dare approach.
